description.value: You've replaced or augmented nearly your entire body, becoming one with your artificial components and crossing the threshold of true cybergenesis. You cease aging, and you no longer need to sleep, eat, drink, or breathe. The first time each day that you would die, you don't. Instead, your body automatically resuscitates itself; you regain a number of Hit Points equal to your level, and you don't increase the value of your wounded condition due to losing the dying condition.
